title: Vegvísir rozbłyskuje — otwarcie bramy
description: Rozbłysk Vegvísiru po zanurzeniu DIAXI. Rytuał otwiera przejście; dopiero potem DIAXI zaczyna płynąć ku powierzchni.

prompts.image: Photoreal live-action cinematic 16:9 insert shot, one image, no bars. Image 1 defines the camera: close DETAIL of the engraved Vegvisir stone, 65mm lens, camera at the level of the carving, the full central glyph occupies most of the frame. Do not reproduce blockout materials. Image 2 is exact stone texture, engraved symbol and elderly hand/sleeve continuity from the preceding shot. Image 3 is exact Vegvisir glyph shape, do not substitute another rune or add letters. Now the shaman's fingertips are still pressed at the same left-of-center groove, her embroidered burgundy/cream sleeve and aged hand enter from lower LEFT. ONLY this one hand and wrist, no face/body or extra hands. The chisel grooves have just flared cold blue-white from contact, forming a readable luminous Vegvisir recessed into wet dark gneiss. This is the first unequivocal magic reveal, opening the waterfall gateway. Bright light stays inside the exact grooves and casts subtle bounced blue light onto wrinkles of the real hand and neighboring rock. Preserve rough mineral grain, fractured stone and sparse moss/lichen. The symbol remains readable: no blown-out white blob, excessive bloom, neon circles or floating sigils. Eye-level real lens, natural perspective and texture, controlled shallow depth only at edges, restrained cold cinematic grade. No waterfall or new background, no captions, subtitles, logos or watermark.
